infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ChivarGo uses your location to check you in, show nearby places, and share your position with a travel party only when you turn sharing on.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ChivarGo uses the camera to capture geo-tagged proof photos for Green Quests.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ChivarGo lets you attach existing photos as quest proof.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: When you explicitly enable Party background sharing or trigger SOS, ChivarGo can keep sharing your location while your phone is locked until you turn it off or the event ends.
